changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/reference-rail-entry-spec-derived.md`

- names `record-reference-rail.tsx` → `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-reference-rail.tsx` — edited by this change

  > `ReferenceRailEntry` is owned by `@objectstack/spec` as of 17.1.0. The hand-written interface in `record-reference-rail.tsx` is replaced by a re-export of the spec's `ReferenceRailEntry` (derived from `ReferenceRailEntrySchema`, `$strict` over `{ objectName, relationshipField, title?, limit?, displayField? }`), and `buildDefaultPageSchema` no longer emits `icon` on the reference-rail entries it synthesizes.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `383a34f52` (merge-base with origin/main): 8 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1539 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2125 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36185112715)

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c01c05855fbf9d7023b7b252c6fd6a2fbf9c1139`

### ① Derived judgments

Read: card objectui#10684 body and its three comments (triage `5837579248`, claim `5837670826`; the `os-dev-report` was not used as evidence), PR objectui#10711 body, file list and check-runs at the head, the diff against the merge-base `383a34f52` (which is also the `main` tip), objectui `AGENTS.md` (版本号策略) and `.changeset/config.json`. All code was read from `refs/review/pr-10711` and `refs/review/main`; nothing was checked out. `@objectstack/spec` is not installed in this container (`/home/user/objectui/node_modules` is absent), and the diff consumes no new spec symbol, so no spec read was needed.

Diff surface: 4 source files, 4 new pin files, 3 new changesets (11 files, +802/-13). The merge commit `c01c05855` adds nothing of its own to any PR file (its diff against its first parent `452d2fb21`, restricted to the PR's files, is empty).

**Scope and limits (triage `5837579248`, claim `5837670826`, the two amendments).**
- Held files: the diff touches none of `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `DetailView.tsx`, `RelatedList.tsx`, `packages/plugin-form/**`, `ObjectGallery.tsx`, `ListView.tsx`. RIGHT.
- No fetch-effect dependency list change: `ObjectTimeline.tsx:490`, `record-reference-rail.tsx:493`, `ReportView.tsx:335-342` and the `refresh` callback deps `RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx:286` are byte-identical to the base. RIGHT.
- No `error` lifecycle rework: the timeline's two `error` writes keep their condition (`setError(null)` still only when the current run commits rows, `:448-450`; `setError(e)` still `isCurrent()`-gated, `:458`). In the rail and the attachments panel the catch arms are gated because they are where `loading`/`status` is released (`record-reference-rail.tsx:422`, `RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx:242`); nothing about how errors are raised, cleared or rendered moves. RIGHT.
- No new published prop, no export or accept-set change: no `index.ts`, zod, spec or prop-type edit is in the diff. RIGHT.

**Site 1, `ObjectTimeline` (`packages/plugin-timeline/src/ObjectTimeline.tsx`).** A data view (reads `schema.objectName` rows, commits `fetchedData`). Had the race at the base: `setFetchedData(data)` and the `finally`'s `setLoading(false)` ran for every run while only the `error` writes read `fetchSeqRef`. Fix: the existing objectui#10663 run number (`:269`, `:367-368`) now also gates the rows commit `:448-449` and the `loading` release `:464`. That is exactly the triage's 「extending the run-sequence ref PR objectui#10680 (merged) added for the `error` writes」. The synchronous `setLoading(true|false)` writes before any await stay unguarded, correctly: they belong to the run executing them. A run that supersedes an in-flight one but does not fetch (the `!objectDefReady` gate) leaves the skeleton up until the next fetching run, and `useSettledSchema` settles on every exit, so no spinner can stick. RIGHT.

**Site 2, `record:reference_rail` (`packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-reference-rail.tsx`).** A data view (per-entry related-record reads committed as `items`). Had the race at the base: commits were gated on the component-lifetime `mountedRef` only, and `states` is keyed by child object name, not by parent, so a previous parent's late answer replaced the current parent's rows and its early failure cleared the current parent's skeleton. Fix: `isCurrent` at `:385` requires `fetchedSigRef.current === sig`, the file's own `(parentId + entriesSig)` signature (`:304`, `:377`); it gates the rows commit `:411`, the loading-off failure commit `:422` and the `entryFields` commit `:460`. A same-signature re-run returns before touching the ref (`:376`), so the mounted-latch promise the file documents still holds (pin control 4). The file's own shape. RIGHT. Nuance, not a defect: a superseded run's worker loop still drains its queue and issues reads for the old parent (`:482-491`, unchanged); their answers are now dropped. Cancelling reads was not asked.

**Site 3, `ReportView` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/ReportView.tsx`).** A data view: a route view that reads report rows and commits `reportRuntimeData`, handed to the renderer as `rows`. Had the race at the base: both async branches committed unconditionally. Fix: an effect-local `cancelled` flag `:268-271`, returned as the cleanup from both async branches (`:308`, `:329`), read at all four commits (`:300`, `:303`, `:321`, `:324`). React runs the cleanup before the next run, so this scopes the commit to the current run; it is the sibling app-shell shape (`RecordDetailView` uses `cancelled`). `ReportView` has no per-fetch `loading` state (its `loading` at `:53` is the metadata provider's), so there is no `loading` release to scope, and the changeset claims none. RIGHT.

**Site 4, `record:attachments` (`packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordAttachmentsPanel.tsx`).** A data view (reads `sys_attachment` rows for the record, commits `rows`; not in the grep lead, found by the census). Had the race at the base: `refresh()` wrote `rows` and moved `status` for every call. Fix: `refreshSeqRef` `:158`, run number taken at `:221-222`, gating the rows commit and the `status` move off `loading` (`:233-238`) and the failure arm (`:242`). A run number rather than an effect cleanup is the right shape here because `refresh` has three callers, the effect `:289`, the upload handler `:316` and Retry `:523`, and an effect cleanup cannot see the last two. Taking the number before the no-input early return (`:221` before `:223`) is documented and consistent with the file's existing "no read issued, status stays" rule. RIGHT.

**Census (the PR body's table, checked row by row against `refs/review/main`).**
- The three the brief names: `ObjectCalendar.tsx` declares `let isMounted = true` at `:617` INSIDE the fetch effect that opens at `:596` and flips it in that effect's own cleanup at `:792`; `ObjectDataTable.tsx` `:691` inside the effect at `:690`, cleanup `:786`; `ObjectPivotTable.tsx` `:190` inside the effect at `:189`, cleanup `:227`. Each is a per-run flag, flipped when the run is superseded or the component unmounts, so each IS a current-run guard. Classified correctly.
- Verified the same way for the other `isMounted` rows: `ObjectKanban.tsx:599`/`:743`, `plugin-view/ObjectView.tsx:1089`/`:1278`, `ObjectGallery.tsx:430`/`:567`, `DetailView.tsx:592`/`:746`; the `cancelled` rows `DatasetWidget.tsx:614`/`:629`, `ObjectTree.tsx:688`/`:871`, `DatasetReportRenderer.tsx:402`/`:430`, `data-list.tsx:134`/`:165`, `record-activity.tsx:202`/`:241`, `record-history.tsx:168`/`:204`, `RelatedList.tsx:936`/`:1102`, `ObjectGrid.tsx:1987`/`:2461`, `MasterDetailForm.tsx:928`/`:952`; the per-run `mounted` objects `ObjectMetricWidget.tsx:438`/`:449` (passed into `fetchMetric`) and `ObjectChart.tsx:975`/`:983`; the sequence refs `ObjectGantt.tsx:832-833`, `ObjectMap.tsx:876-877`, `ListView.tsx:2144`/`:2567`; `RecordDetailView.tsx` feed reads (`:1694`, `:1748`) land in `feedItemsByRecord[threadId]` with a `cancelled` settle key at the effect's end. All correctly "guarded".
- `LineItemsPanel.tsx`: the `load` read at `:322` has no run guard (the `cancelled` at `:230-234` belongs to the child-schema effect). "Unguarded by reading", held: correct, and correctly not edited.
- Omissions: an independent sweep of every `.find(` call in `packages/*/src` (tests excluded) found no data view outside the table. The extra hits are `Array.prototype.find`, comments, field widgets (`useRecordQuery`, `LookupField`, pickers), one-shot utilities (`LiveReportExporter.ts:122`), count probes (`containers.tsx:779`, `app-shell/ObjectView.tsx:2241`), or already guarded (`record-picker.tsx:129-162`, the `elements.tsx` number element). `RecordDetailView`'s own record read (`:516-547`) is not in the table but is `cancelled`-guarded, so nothing is missing. No missing ask.

**Existing pins edited or deleted:** none. The diff adds four test files and modifies no existing test.

**New pins.** Every `find` returns a hand-held deferred; the settle order is stated per case; no timers and no fake timers; `waitFor` is used only to wait for the effect cascade to issue a read, never for ordering, so the pins cannot flake on timing. Each file carries a lit control ("a single read renders, as before", `find` called once). Negative legs, by reading the base: `SchemaRenderer` keys nothing on the schema (`packages/react/src/SchemaRenderer.tsx:2194-2229`, no `key` in the created element) and `RecordContextProvider` is a plain provider (`RecordContext.tsx:206-234`), so a filter or `recordId` change re-renders the same block instance; a base-shaped commit therefore lands on the live component and the superseded rows show (`currentShown=false, supersededShown=true`), and the base `finally` / mounted-latch / status write takes the skeleton down early. All three `SchemaRenderer` pins go red at the base and green at the head. `ReportView.supersededRows-10684.test.tsx`: the reads are real (`find('acct')` issued by the component's own effect, then `find('other')` after the route moves), the superseded answer is resolved last, and the observed seam is the `rows` prop `ReportView` hands its renderer; at the base the unconditional commit hands `[Superseded row]`, at the head it is dropped. It discriminates. The stub sits one level below the fixed component (the same harness as `ReportView.dataSourceObjectKey.test.tsx`), which is the nearest observable seam for a route view; acceptable. Two cases pass at the base by design and are labelled so in the PR body (timeline case 3, rail control 4).

**Done that was not asked:** nothing beyond the guards, their comments and the pins. **Asked and missing:** nothing.

### ② Semver level

Three `patch` changesets, one per touched released package: `@object-ui/plugin-timeline`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell` (all in the `fixed` group of `.changeset/config.json`). Not docs-only. AGENTS.md 版本号策略 forbids `major` and reserves `minor` for objectui's own breaking changes; a behaviour fix with no export, prop, schema or accept-set change is `patch`. RIGHT.

Changeset prose, sentence by sentence against the diff:
- `10684-timeline-superseded-rows.md`: title, TRUE. "numbers the runs of its fetch, but only its `error` writes read that number", TRUE at the base. "The rows and the loading flag were written by every run", TRUE. "a new filter, sort or object, or a data-invalidation re-read", TRUE (all in the deps at `:490`). "An earlier read that settled first also cleared the loading skeleton", TRUE. "Only the current run writes the rows and clears the loading flag now", TRUE (`:448-449`, `:464`). "dropped when it arrives", TRUE. "still clears the loading flag on every exit, including a failed read", TRUE (the `finally`).
- `10684-reference-rail-superseded-parent.md`: title, TRUE. "applies its answers while it is mounted, whichever run started the read", TRUE at the base (`:294-298`). "could arrive after the current record's answer and replace its rows", TRUE (states keyed by object name). "settle first and clear the entry's skeleton", TRUE. "applied now only while the record and entries it was read for are still the ones on screen", TRUE (`:385`). "A re-render for the same record starts no new read, so the answer in flight still lands", TRUE (`:376`, pin control 4).
- `10684-report-attachments-superseded-read.md`: title, TRUE. "`ReportView` read its report's rows with no check that the read was still the current one", TRUE at the base. "another report on the same route, a config-panel edit or a metadata refresh", TRUE (`reportName` through `initialReport` at `:56`; `editSchema`; the `initialReport` sync effect). "drops an answer once a newer run has started", TRUE. "wrote its list and its loading status on every refresh", TRUE at the base.
